single_message_false_negatives.preview:
"GUI и USB-транспорт стали отдельными модулями" - не стали сами, а ты сделал их отдельными

"интерфейс не зависает" - не сам не зависает, а ты сделал чтобы интерфейс не зависал

"Установка на новой машине Astra заняла одну команду" - не установка сама заняла, а ты обеспечил возможность установки одной командой


но на самом деле это уже настолько мелкая шлифовка, что я не уверен в ее влиянии на конверсию, по факту текущие формулировки уже будет помечаться hh как конкретные достижения

scoring: Do not globally lower 0.55 threshold from this sample. Add targeted boosts for numbered product-feedback lists, concrete before/after resume examples, technical cost/cache explanations, and resource-link-with-context answers. Penalize welcome templates, promo/ad tone, social/crypto chatter, and media/no-text.
clustering: Current live path had no clusters. Needed grouping is mostly same chat/topic/thread discussion segment, not semantic macroclustering. Same-timestamp burst grouping is important for raw 6219-6226. Cross-post/resource dedupe is needed for Lampa StreamBert.
discussion_segment: Expected materials requiring discussion segment: E01,E02,E03,E04,E07,E08 = 6 of 10 expected items, or 6 of 8 useful expected materials. Proposed rule: same account/chat/topic/thread, max 6 messages, max 20 minutes default, allow same-timestamp bursts, min combined score 0.55, require at least 2 distinct useful signals, stop on topic switch/long silence/media-only/noise streak.
llm_judge: No true LLM false negative for raw 6716 alone; it was correct. Need pair/chain-level judge after answer appears. Approved decisions now include SINGLE_MESSAGE_MATERIAL_CANDIDATE and DIRECT_MATERIAL_READY. Enforce strict output schema and log parsed decision/generation skip reason.
material_generation: Bug found earlier: accepted decision value was not approved. Add explicit generation skipped reason per candidate, not only aggregate LLM_REJECTED_ALL.
dedupe: No overnight duplicate guard failure. Existing material 12 overlaps hh resume theme; future dedupe should support update/merge rather than suppressing a richer new answer.
